address: 14 Silver Street, Bradford-on-Avon, BA15 1JY, United Kingdom
bio: The Bunch of Grapes might be the oldest pub in this historic town but it now comes with an appealing modern edge and a deli selling tempting treats. Downstairs has a pubby feel, while upstairs has more of a restaurant vibe, and you can have anything from a burger to an ambitious tasting menu....
